title: Repair GMGN cost alias precedence and zero timestamp semantics
objective: Use independently audited one-request 30d alias-shape evidence and pinned gmgn-cli@1.5.4 skill semantics to stop treating bought_cost and total_cost as unconditional equal aliases. Prefer the documented bought_cost field family and use total_cost only as a fallback family, retain fail-closed conflicts inside a chosen family, treat an explicit zero last_timestamp as an unavailable sentinel rather than an invalid type or fabricated activity, and add pure offline synthetic tests. No live request.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue network/provider/GMGN CLI requests or read credentials/real addresses.
Do not equate bought_cost and total_cost when both are present with different values.
Do not infer tradeCount, periodPnl, timestamps, or missing values.
Do not output timestamp zero as verified activity; zero may only be omitted as a provider unavailable sentinel.
Do not relax period, envelope, ownership, numeric lexical, range, integer, or win-rate contracts.
Do not modify transport, holdings, batch execution, database, cache, queue, or production systems.
